name: HybridX Run
description: Record your runs and get a VO2max estimate from steady running, worked out on the watch from pace, gradient and heart rate.

configFields.label: Birth year
configFields.description: Used for your age, which sets your max heart rate if you don't enter one. 0 leaves it unset.

configFields.label: Birth month
configFields.description: 1 for January to 12 for December. 0 counts as January.

configFields.label: Max heart rate
configFields.description: Your measured max heart rate, if you know it: it makes the estimate more accurate. 0 calculates it from your age.

configFields.label: Resting heart rate
configFields.description: 0 uses the resting heart rate your watch measures.
